name: Ranatec AB — API and machine-readable resource catalog
description: All machine-readable resources published for ranatec.com: agent page, llms.txt, ai.txt, REST API (/agent/v1), OpenAPI, MCP server, sitemap and robots.txt.

apis.name: Ranatec agent page
apis.description: Complete semantic HTML representation of ranatec.com with schema.org JSON-LD (Organization, Product ×49, FAQPage, Person, ItemList).

apis.name: llms.txt
apis.description: Markdown index following llmstxt.org, covering all three regional locales.

apis.name: ai.txt
apis.description: AI usage permissions, canonical sources and citation guidance.

apis.name: API catalog
apis.description: This file (APIs.json 0.16). RFC 9727 linkset equivalent at /.well-known/api-catalog.

apis.name: Ranatec Agent API
apis.description: Read-only JSON API describing Ranatec AB (Gothenburg, Sweden) — RF test & measurement equipment for filtering, shielding, switching and automation — plus one consent-gated POST endpoint for quote requests and enquiries. Content mirrors ranatec.com in three regional English locales (en-US default, en-GB, en-CA); every entity lists all three URLs. Ranatec publishes no prices: all products are sold B2B via request for quote.
apis.X-purpose: Structured company, product, news and FAQ data; quote requests

properties.description: API index, counts and discovery links
Field reference and conventions
Company profile, contact, certifications, locales, partners, careers
List products (full specifications unless fields=summary)
One product by id (slug) or model number
Product categories
One category with its products (summary fields)
Product domains and solution areas
News, product launches, technical articles, events (newest first)
One news item by slug
Site pages with en-US / en-GB / en-CA URLs
Frequently asked questions
Backend for the MCP tool submit_inquiry (AI agents: use the MCP tool, not this path) — requires agent_context.user_authorized_submission: true

apis.name: Ranatec MCP server
apis.description: Model Context Protocol server exposing Ranatec company, product, news and FAQ data as tools, plus a consent-gated quote/enquiry tool.

properties.name: get_company
properties.description: Company profile, contact details, certifications, locales, partners and careers.

properties.name: list_products
properties.description: List products, filterable by category, domain, listing, model or text query.

properties.name: get_product
properties.description: Full specifications for one product by id or model number (e.g. "RI 268").

properties.name: compare_products
properties.description: Side-by-side specification comparison of 2–6 products.

properties.name: list_categories
properties.description: Product categories with summaries and product ids.

properties.name: list_solutions
properties.description: Product domains and solution areas (wireless test automation, shielded enclosures, custom equipment).

properties.name: list_news
properties.description: News, product launches, technical articles and events; filter by type, year, product or text.

properties.name: get_news_item
properties.description: Full text of one news item or article.

properties.name: search
properties.description: Full-text search across products, news and FAQ.

properties.name: get_faq
properties.description: Frequently asked questions with answers and sources.

properties.name: list_pages
properties.description: Site pages with en-US, en-GB and en-CA URLs.

properties.name: submit_inquiry
properties.description: The only supported way for AI agents to send a lead (quote request or enquiry) to Ranatec — requires explicit user consent (user_authorized_submission: true). Callable via an MCP connector or a plain HTTP JSON-RPC tools/call.

apis.name: XML sitemap
apis.description: Yoast SEO sitemap index (pages, posts, products, product categories).

apis.name: robots.txt
apis.description: Crawler rules; AI crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, …) are allowed.

apis.name: Request a quote
apis.description: Human RFQ page — products are added to an RFQ list and submitted.
